title: 06. Memory, State & HITL: The Messages List — The Agent's Memory
summary: The Messages List — The Agent's Memory: explanations and runnable examples.
objectives: The Messages List — The Agent's Memory

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
```
THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT CONCEPT.
Every single thing that happens gets added to this list.
OpenAI reads the ENTIRE list on every API call.

MESSAGES LIST GROWS LIKE THIS:
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

START:
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ messages = [                                             │
│   { role: "system",  content: "You are a helpful..." } │
│   { role: "user",    content: "What is 99 * 88?" }     │
│ ]                                                        │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
         │ send to OpenAI
         ▼ OpenAI says: use calculator tool
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ messages = [                                             │
│   { role: "system",  content: "You are a helpful..." } │
│   { role: "user",    content: "What is 99 * 88?" }     │
│   { role: "assistant",  ◄── ADD: OpenAI's tool request │
│     tool_calls: [{                                       │
│       id: "call_abc",                                    │
│       function: {                                        │
│         name: "calculator",                              │
│         arguments: '{"expression": "99 * 88"}'          │
│       }                                                  │
│     }]                                                   │
│   }                                                      │
│ ]                                                        │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
         │ YOUR code runs calculator("99 * 88") → "8712"
         ▼ Append the result
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ messages = [                                             │
│   { role: "system",  content: "You are a helpful..." } │
│   { role: "user",    content: "What is 99 * 88?" }     │
│   { role: "assistant", tool_calls: [...] }              │
│   { role: "tool",    ◄── ADD: your tool's result        │
│     tool_call_id: "call_abc",  ◄── MUST match above id  │
│     content: "Result: 8712"                              │
│   }                                                      │
│ ]                                                        │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
         │ send to OpenAI again
         ▼ OpenAI reads everything, says: I have the answer
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ messages = [                                             │
│   { role: "system",  ... }                              │
│   { role: "user",    ... }                              │
│   { role: "assistant", tool_calls: [...] }              │
│   { role: "tool",    content: "Result: 8712" }          │
│   { role: "assistant",  ◄── ADD: final answer           │
│     content: "99 × 88 = 8,712"                          │
│   }                                                      │
│ ]                                                        │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

DONE ✅ — Show user: "99 × 88 = 8,712"
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
```
